content.short: Multisender is a batch transfer tool for sending tokens or NFTs to many wallet addresses in a single workflow.
content.description: Multisender is a distribution tool for projects, communities, and operators that need to send assets to many recipients at once. The product supports batch transfers, airdrops, and payout flows across multiple networks, including TON. Instead of sending one transaction per address, users can upload a prepared list, connect a wallet, and execute a bulk transfer process that is designed to save time and reduce manual work during token or NFT distribution campaigns, treasury operations, and community reward programs.
content.meta: Multisender helps teams run token, NFT, and payout distributions in bulk. Explore Multisender and other TON tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
